description: Signal réseau Corse - Recharge véhicule électrique is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by EDF Corse. Les spécificités du système électrique insulaire de la Corse incitent à prendre des précautions concernant le développement de la mobilité électrique. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Transport & Mobility. Its keywords are Recharge véhicules électriques, Signal, Réseau, Smart charging. The portal shows 288 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2018-05-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
